correctness.rationale: The exact leaf birth transition is Bernoulli with probability q(1-L/j); its expectation recurrence is affine with deterministic contraction. The continuum ODE gives an order-one uniform mean-centering error because x has integrable second derivative. Centered fluctuations are deterministic transforms of bounded martingale increments, yielding exponentially summable uniform concentration and a functional martingale CLT with explicit quadratic variation. An integrable singular drift is controlled near zero, and the limiting Volterra equation yields the Gaussian kernel. Direct integration verifies beta=1 benchmarks; dominated limits verify beta down to zero and up to infinity. The independent finite checker passed 343 assertions from actual saved code; it is not used as proof of infinite claims.

value.rationale: The count of terminal leaves is a natural microscopic structural observable of the 2026 aggregation tree family, not determined by the existing GHP scaling description. The result gives the entire time-indexed Gaussian covariance structure for a continuous range of polynomial intensities, interpolates two classical tree benchmarks and proves a nonmonotone fluctuation response despite monotone leaf density.
